CA.title: British Columbia Adopts Permanent Daylight Saving Time
CA.excerpt: British Columbia has adopted Permanent Daylight Saving Time. The clock change on March 8, 2026 will be the province's final seasonal time shift.

VN.title: Vietnam Adds New Public Holiday on November 24
VN.excerpt: Vietnam is set to add a new paid public holiday on November 24 to promote culture and heritage as the country undergoes rapid economic growth.
